title: Operational Control Inspection Checklist
description: Completed by OM or Apron Supervisor: minimum weekly, and after any triggering event.

footer.dateLine: Date: March 12, 2026. Maintenance Paved and Unpaved Manual.

items.text: No potholes or bowl-shaped depressions anywhere on runway surface
No cracking producing loose asphalt or aggregate (FOD hazard)
Widths of all cracks ≥ 3 mm measured and recorded in Remarks column
No alligator/fatigue cracking pattern covering > 0.5 m²
No rutting deeper than 12 mm (measure with 1.2 m straightedge if suspected)
No depressions collecting standing water (identified by wet patches after rain)
No shoving or plastic deformation visible in runway surface
No raveling (loose aggregate at surface) creating FOD hazard
Rubber deposits in touchdown zones — rated: None / Low / Medium / High
Runway shoulder edges at correct elevation (no drop-off > 50 mm)
Runway drainage gutters (both edges) free of sediment and blockage

sections.title: SECTION 2 — TAXIWAY SURFACES (CONCRETE) Alpha, Bravo, Charlie.

items.text: No potholes or loose slab fragments on any taxiway
No joint spalling with loose concrete any loose pieces collected
Joint sealant condition acceptable (no voids > 6 mm; sealant not extruded above slab)
No transverse or longitudinal cracking > 12 mm wide on any taxiway
No corner breaks on any concrete slabs
No pumping visible (water/fines ejected at joints under traffic)
No differential settlement between adjacent slabs > 6 mm
Taxiway Alpha shoulders (7.5 m each side) intact and at correct elevation
Drainage gutters adjacent to all taxiways clear and functional
Turn pads at both runway ends surface free of potholes and loose material
Turn pad joint seals acceptable
Turn pad drainage functional
Turn pad surrounds free of objects > 7.5 cm height
No spalled concrete with loose FOD on apron
No cracked or lifted slab corners
All expansion and contraction joints sealed no open voids > 6 mm
No differential slab settlement > 6 mm
No fuel or oil contamination degrading surface
Apron drainage (channels, drains, sumps) fully clear and functional
No standing water on any part of apron 30 min after end of rainfall
RESA (Threshold 07 end) no obstacles > 7.5 cm, level surface, no standing water
RESA (Threshold 25 end) no obstacles > 7.5 cm, level surface, no standing water
Runway strip grass areas grass within 20–38 cm range
Runway strip no objects exceeding 7.5 cm height in cleared area
Runway strip unpaved areas no significant saturated or flooded zones
Runway centerline continuous, white, full runway length, no major gaps
Runway threshold markings Threshold 07 all bars present, white, visible
Runway threshold markings Threshold 25 all bars present, white, visible
Runway designation '07’ legible, correct numerals
Runway designation '25’ legible, correct numerals
Runway aiming point markings visible at both ends
Runway touchdown zone markings visible at both ends
Holding position markings (all runway/taxiway intersections) yellow, full pattern, visible
Taxiway Alpha centerline yellow, continuous, full length
Taxiway Bravo centerline yellow, continuous
Taxiway Charlie centerline yellow, continuous
Taxiway edge markings visible on all taxiways
Apron aircraft stand numbers visible and legible
Apron lead-in lines visible on active stands
No marking segment obscured by rubber deposits, dirt, or water staining to unacceptable level
All mandatory instruction signs (red/white) face intact, legend legible
Runway 07 designation mandatory sign intact and illuminated (if night/reduced vis.)
Runway 25 designation mandatory sign intact and illuminated (if night/reduced vis.)
All location signs (yellow text on black) face intact, legend legible
All direction signs (black text on yellow) face intact, arrows correct and legible
All runway distance remaining signs present, correct numerals, intact
No signs with cracked, missing, or shattered face panels
No signs with bent or severely corroded mounting posts
No signs displaced or tilted > 3° from vertical
No signs obscured by vegetation
Electrical malfunction noted: refer to EEC per Annex 2-2 (list in Remarks if applicable)
All runway edge drainage channels visually clear, no overflow onto runway
All taxiway drainage channels clear and flowing
All visible apron drainage channels and sumps clear
No erosion channels created by surface water runoff at pavement edges
No sedimentation visible in drainage channels reducing flow capacity by >50%
